requirement.description: The IOPort class has issues with string representation and transformation. Tests are failing with "Cannot transform value (io-port None)" indicating that IOPort objects aren't properly handled in IR generation.
requirement.contract: Ensure IOPort objects can be properly transformed to their string representations and handled correctly in IR generation. The __str__ method should return a proper representation like "(io-port name)" and the __repr__ method should return a proper AST representation.

requirement.description: IOPort constructor validation has issues with name parameter. Tests are failing with "IOPort name must be a string, not 3" but the validation seems to be incorrectly rejecting valid cases.
requirement.contract: Fix IOPort constructor to properly validate that name is a string when provided, and ensure that when name is None, it is handled correctly without raising TypeError.

requirement.description: Layout classes (StructLayout, UnionLayout) have issues with integer conversion, causing "TypeError: 'StructLayout' object cannot be interpreted as an integer" errors.
requirement.contract: Implement proper __int__ method for Layout classes that returns the size of the layout, not just raises an error. The conversion should return the total bit width of the layout.

requirement.description: Value conversion to string fails with "Value (sig s) cannot be converted to string" errors. This happens when trying to represent signals in error messages.
requirement.contract: Implement proper __str__ and __repr__ methods for Value subclasses to ensure they can be converted to strings for error reporting and debugging purposes.

requirement.description: Enum classes are missing the from_bits method, causing AttributeError when tests try to call it.
requirement.contract: Add from_bits method to Enum classes to support bit conversion operations consistent with other Amaranth data types.
